title: WidgetPipelineSpec
description: A pipeline specification for a dashboard widget. Describes an ordered sequence of skill invocations that fetch, transform, and render data.

refresh_interval_seconds.description: How often to refresh the widget data, in seconds

widget_id.description: Optional unique identifier for this widget instance. Generated automatically if omitted.

thinking.description: Optional reasoning about the pipeline design

pipeline.description: Ordered list of pipeline steps to execute

id.description: Unique identifier for this step. Referenced by later steps via {{step_id.output}}.

params.description: Skill-specific parameters. Values may contain {{step_id.output}} references to previous step outputs.
